FIELDS.NAME: Creative Crafts & Hobbies
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Craft Lane, Suite A, Hobbytown, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Crafts & Hobbies operates as a retail store specializing in a wide range of hobby and craft supplies, including materials for scrapbooking, knitting, painting, and model building. Our core operations include the sale of quality art supplies, crafting tools, and DIY kits, while maintaining a clean and well-organized store environment that prioritizes customer safety and accessibility. We offer various instructional classes and workshops aimed at enhancing creative skills, fully covered by appropriate professional liability insurance. Our inventory management practices involve regular stock audits and secure storage measures to minimize loss, ensuring compliance with local fire and safety codes. Our dedication to customer satisfaction and community engagement fosters a positive shopping experience, supported by knowledgeable staff ready to assist and inspire creativity among our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a burst pipe caused water damage in the craft supplies section, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The damage was promptly addressed, and all repairs were completed by March 25, 2023. Currently, the status is closed with no further claims.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: 1 safe, UL-listed, heavy-duty steel construction, Class 1, Grade B, for secure storage of valuable inventory and cash.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fully equipped with professional-grade fencing and monitored by licensed security personnel during operational hours.
